{{recipe}} 

This three-course '''prime rib dinner''' consists of juicy rib roast with roast vegetables and apple ginger flambe, which will rival even the best prime rib palace.

== Ingredients ==

=== Prime rib ===
* 1 prime-grade 4-bone standing [[Cookbook:Beef#Loin|rib roast from the loin end]], bones removed
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* Freshly ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]], finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 2 tsp [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]], finely chopped
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
* 2 tsp [[Cookbook:Garlic Powder|garlic powder]]

=== Roast vegetables ===
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] red-skinned [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]], cut into 2-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] cubes
* 3 [[Cookbook:Parsnip|parsnips]], peeled and sliced into 1 ½ inch pieces
* Salt
* Freshly ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]
* ¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] olive oil
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] minced [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]

=== Apple ginger flambé ===
* 2 [[Cookbook:Apple|apples]], sliced into ½ inch wedges
* 2 tbsp dark [[Cookbook:Rum|rum]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Hazelnut|hazelnut]] oil
* ¼ cup crystallized [[Cookbook:Ginger|ginger]], finely chopped
* Pinch of salt
* [[Cookbook:Powdered Sugar|Powdered sugar]]
* 1 tbsp unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Apple Cider|apple cider]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Heavy Cream|heavy cream]]
* 1 tbsp granulated sugar

== Procedure ==

=== Roast vegetables ===
#Bring a large pot of salted water to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]]. Add potatoes and cook for 10 minutes.
#Shock potatoes in a bowl of ice water. Place on a cooling rack and let dry for 2 hours.
#Toss parsnips and potatoes with olive oil. Sprinkle liberally with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at 450°F for 25 minutes. Keep warm in a different oven than the prime rib.

=== Prime rib ===
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] rib roast with olive oil. Combine seasonings for prime rib and rub into meat. Insert a probe [[Cookbook:Thermometer|thermometer]] into the center of the roast.
#Bake at 200°F until internal temperature reaches 118°F. Remove from oven while oven heats back up to 500°F.
#Place roast back in oven and cook until internal temperature reaches 135°F. Remove and let rest for 10 minutes. Serve with roast vegetables.

=== Apple ginger flambé ===
#Once you've finished dinner, make the flambe table-side with a hot plate. You might want a fire extinguisher just in case.
#Heat oil in a 10-inch stainless steel [[Cookbook:Skillet|skillet]] over medium high heat. Add apples and [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] until a golden color is achieved.
#Pour out any remaining oil. Add rum and ignite. Scrape bottom of pan with a metal [[Cookbook:Whisk|whisk]] until browned bits are dissolved. Pour out of pan and reserve.
#Melt butter in same pan, still over medium high heat. Once bubbling stops, whisk in flour and whisk continuously until light blond color is achieved.
#Add remaining ingredients except for powdered sugar and also add the rum and boil until reduced by half. Add apples and [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|toss]] to coat. Serve warm, dusted with powdered sugar.

steps.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add potatoes and cook for 10 minutes.
Shock potatoes in a bowl of ice water. Place on a cooling rack and let dry for 2 hours.
Toss parsnips and potatoes with olive oil. Sprinkle liberally with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
Bake at 450°F for 25 minutes. Keep warm in a different oven than the prime rib.
Brush rib roast with olive oil. Combine seasonings for prime rib and rub into meat. Insert a probe thermometer into the center of the roast.
Bake at 200°F until internal temperature reaches 118°F. Remove from oven while oven heats back up to 500°F.
Place roast back in oven and cook until internal temperature reaches 135°F. Remove and let rest for 10 minutes. Serve with roast vegetables.
Once you've finished dinner, make the flambe table-side with a hot plate. You might want a fire extinguisher just in case.
Heat oil in a 10-inch stainless steel skillet over medium high heat. Add apples and sauté until a golden color is achieved.
Pour out any remaining oil. Add rum and ignite. Scrape bottom of pan with a metal whisk until browned bits are dissolved. Pour out of pan and reserve.
Melt butter in same pan, still over medium high heat. Once bubbling stops, whisk in flour and whisk continuously until light blond color is achieved.
Add remaining ingredients except for powdered sugar and also add the rum and boil until reduced by half. Add apples and toss to coat. Serve warm, dusted with powdered sugar.
